title: Settings name updates are not reflected in detail view without restart
raw_input: After editing the display name in settings, the updated name does not appear in the detail view until restarting the app.

plan.title: Settings name updates are not reflected in detail view without restart
plan.summary: When a user edits their display name in settings, the detail view continues to display the old name.
repro_steps: Launch the app and navigate to settings.
plan.expected_behavior: The detail view should reflect the new display name without restart.
acceptance_criteria: Display name changes in settings are reactively updated in the detail view.
constraints: Must adhere to existing SwiftUI state management patterns.
